detail.securityNote.clean: This entry passed our published checklist, and on the date shown a scan of its download page raised no warnings. It is not an audit or a guarantee — software can change after a check. Download only from the official link, and verify signatures or checksums where the developer offers them.
detail.securityNote.title: What this status means
detail.securityNote.unverified: The checklist has not been completed for this entry, or something it found needs a closer look. It meets every other rule of the list. Take the care you would with any download, and prefer the official link.
error.403.body: Nothing on SoftHarbor requires permission, so this is unexpected. If you reached this page, please report it.
error.403.title: Access denied
error.404.body: The link may be old, or the entry may have been removed — flagged apps are quarantined rather than kept live.
error.404.title: That page isn't here
error.429.body: You have been rate limited. The public dataset at /api/apps.json exists precisely so tools do not have to scrape the pages.
error.429.title: Too many requests
error.500.body: SoftHarbor is a static site, so this should be impossible. If you are seeing it, the report button in the footer helps.
error.500.title: Something broke
error.offline.body: SoftHarbor needs a connection to load new pages. It is a directory of links, so there is nothing useful to show you offline.
